scene: The clanking car glides skyward over glowing rain barrels and cloud tanks.
beats: You trade a pocket mint for dried sourfruit as the car docks, the cabin chime ringing as the doors glide open.
A tinny chime ripples overhead, coaxing sleepy fireflies from the ceiling vent just as the doors open at the terrace.
Tracing the neon line reveals a hidden observatory spur, right as the funicular halts and slides its brass doors wide.
picture: Inside a slanting glass-and-brass cabin, a passenger sits left clutching starfruit chips. The player stands centre in corduroy jacket and beanie, brass telescope slung. Up high, a winding music box gleams on the ceiling beam. On the right, a route map glows. Outside, rooftop rain barrels glow far below.
shown: a passenger holding a bag of starfruit chips on the left
a brass lullaby box mounted beneath the window up high
a glowing constellation map frame mounted on the right wall

after.beat: The car glides past the platform, whistling softly into the dark. At the terminus, a friendly tow truck picks you up and rumbles into Neon Sign Hospital amidst flickering, mended rainbow glass.
after.then: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital
